tool_result:
Current capabilities:
• runtime_core: Nova runs as a local runtime with core state, heartbeat, HTTP, CLI, and service surfaces
• guard_system: Nova has a guard process and maintenance loop that supervise runtime health
• work_tree: Nova can organize internal work into trees, branches, tasks, tool evidence, and blocker state
• health_monitoring: Nova can inspect health score, dependency state, Work Tree truth, release readiness, and runtime alerts
• memory_systems: Nova has memory and identity plumbing for continuity when enabled and valid
• task_routing: Nova routes user and maintenance intent through command, supervisor, planner, and tool-dispatch paths
• maintenance_loops: Nova can run recurring maintenance cycles for generated work, Work Tree intake, release checks, and cleanup observation
• release_verification: Nova can inspect release readiness, validation outcomes, rebuild state, and promotion judgment
• subconscious_priority: Nova can read subconscious priority output and route generated pressure into Work Tree review
• autonomy_handling: Nova has autonomy advisory, execution gate, action ledger, and active Work Tree execution machinery
• operator_outbox: Nova can publish operator-facing notices when autonomous work is blocked or needs help
• web_access: Nova can retrieve information from allowed websites
• file_read: Nova can read files within allowed root directory
• file_search: Nova can search files for keywords
• system_checks: Nova can run local system health checks and diagnostics
• queue_status: Nova can inspect its standing generated work queue and report the next open regression item
• vision: Nova can analyze screenshots or camera input
• speech_to_text: Nova can transcribe voice input
• text_to_speech: Nova can speak responses
